notes.title: Girl Amazon Survival Private Alpha has already started!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thank you for participating in the Girl Amazon Survival Private Alpha! 

[h1]Find opponents in the official group[/h1]
If you're having trouble finding players, please join the official [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/372750]Girl Amazon Survival[/url] Steam Group - and add other members as friends to invite into a game. 

[h1]The purpose of the alpha test - find bugs[/h1]
If you find any bug, please report it on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/372750/discussions/]forum[/url].

[h1]Suggest your ideas for the game![/h1]
If you have any idea for the Girl Amazon Survival, report it on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/372750/discussions/]forum[/url].
All the ideas we take to examining.

Thank you for being with us, Kobra Studio.
